title: geocode.v1
description: One geocoder answer for one query string, in a CACHE (rewritten, not append-only). Google Maps Platform terms allow caching latitude/longitude for at most 30 days, while place_id may be kept indefinitely. So the entry is keyed by place_id: `result.point` is present only until `expires_at`, and `llens geocode` re-resolves a stale entry by place_id and strips expired points when it rewrites the cache. The result shape is listing.v1's own geocode block, referenced, not copied.

query.description: The exact string sent (phrase plus region suffix). Never the request URL: it carries the key.

place_id.description: The provider's stable place id: the durable cache key, kept indefinitely.

expires_at.description: resolved_at + the provider's coordinate-cache limit (30 days for Google). After it, result.point must be gone.
